_about: Hand-modeled NBA picks the RealGM parser (tools/nba_picks_parse.py) can't read or RealGM doesn't list. Each row replaces the parsed row for that pick: [original team, year, round, goes to, kind, note, team that keeps it if protected]. 'seen' is RealGM's text for the pick when the row was written; when RealGM's text changes, the build prints a warning so the row gets another look.
